description:
Problem
The shared download_document Action advertises document_mime_type and forwards it to materialization. A valid WhatsApp image handle succeeds alone but fails with the correct image/jpeg argument because communication materialization rejects the option. Trusted source MIME is already in the signed handle.

Scope
Correct the shared tool/materialization contract using trusted metadata. Investigate source-MIME option handling at the shared boundary rather than reinstating the discarded communication-specific workaround by default. Preserve authorization, handle verification, provider routing and supported explicit export-format selection. Quoted-reply resolution and timezone tests are outside scope.

Required immutable regression
test/zaq/agent/tools/data_source/download_document_mime_regression_test.exs
SHA-256: b192927cefdec39ff340d51d758e94fb73d88d6a6bfdfbf4bf3e9e500ba7e3bf

Acceptance / validation
1. The entire regression test file must remain byte-for-byte unchanged, including assertions, fixtures, fake router, execution path and control case.
2. Run mix test test/zaq/agent/tools/data_source/download_document_mime_regression_test.exs and obtain 1 test, 0 failures, with the test executed (no skip, exclusion or tagging bypass).
3. Verify the file SHA-256 still matches the baseline above.
4. Achieve the passing result through production behavior changes, not test-only hooks, environment tricks or altered test infrastructure.
5. Handle-only and matching-MIME calls must both return the expected image content and dispatch through Channels, as already asserted.
6. Preserve existing test behavior; run relevant adjacent tests and mix q under the repository validation lifecycle.

Current evidence
Baseline run: 1 test, 1 failure at the second Jido.Exec.run call, with Record materialization failed: :invalid_materialization_options. The preceding handle-only call and dispatch assertion pass. mix q passes. Regression file is currently uncommitted; preserve it when moving work.

Action reuse assessment
Reuse the existing DownloadDocument Action via Jido.Exec.run/3, Materialization, registered handlers and Channels dispatch. Extend the existing shared contract; do not create another download operation. Inputs are a signed handle and supported representation options; source identity and authorization remain backend-owned. Verification uses the immutable public Action regression and adjacent materializer tests.

Related
zaq-df1 retains original incident evidence and discarded implementation history. This issue tracks the clean-baseline fix with the immutable-test acceptance gate explicitly requested by the user.

comments.text:
Implementation plan and Action reuse reassessment:
Reuse DownloadDocument -> Materialization -> existing registered handlers and NodeRouter. Materialization owns shared option interpretation; handlers own source-specific locator validation, authorization and role dispatch. No new Action, provider branches, callback abstraction or runtime state.
Baseline immutable test reconfirmed RED (1 test, 1 failure, invalid_materialization_options); SHA-256 matches recorded value.
Change Materialization.materialize_with_handler/4 to resolve the common document_mime_type fallback before strict handler-option validation: discard it when the handler does not consume source-MIME options or when the trusted locator already has document_mime_type; retain it only for compatible document handles lacking source MIME. Locator remains authoritative, and unknown/atom-keyed options plus unsupported export options still fail. DataSourceDocument already forwards locator MIME for export defaults.
Update DownloadDocument descriptions and owning service documentation to state metadata precedence. Preserve schema/legacy fallback and explicit export selection so existing scenarios remain intact.
Add separate validated Action property tests for source-MIME precedence and communication-hint independence, plus option/authorization checks. Immutable regression and existing tests remain untouched. No browser E2E needed for this backend contract regression.
Rollback criteria: unexpected source/export behavior changes, lost option/identity validation, or any need to weaken existing tests. No lifecycle/dependency changes. Delivery stays in the current working tree as authorized; no commit/push.

Shared-boundary implementation and focused validation complete. Source MIME options are resolved before strict handler validation: signed document metadata wins; communication downloads discard the unused source hint without changing CommunicationMedia. Legacy no-source document fallback and explicit export choice remain supported. Added independent Action property tests and guards; no existing test edits. Focused run passed: 5 properties, 74 tests, 0 failures. mix q passed. Immutable regression SHA-256 remains b192927cefdec39ff340d51d758e94fb73d88d6a6bfdfbf4bf3e9e500ba7e3bf. Final precommit validation follows.

Implementation and local validation complete. Immutable acceptance command passed exactly: 1 test, 0 failures; test SHA-256 still b192927cefdec39ff340d51d758e94fb73d88d6a6bfdfbf4bf3e9e500ba7e3bf, byte-for-byte unchanged. Focused adjacent suite: 5 properties, 74 tests, 0 failures. mix q passed. Final mix precommit passed with exit status 0: 518.2 seconds, 17 doctests, 199 properties, 9962 tests, 0 failures, 1 skipped, 117 excluded; seed 632150. Logs /tmp/zaq-pcj-precommit.log and status /tmp/zaq-pcj-precommit.status. Shared Materialization resolves fallback source MIME before handler-option validation, preserves signed metadata and explicit supported exports, and leaves CommunicationMedia unchanged. Separate tests cover precedence, hint independence, legacy fallback, invalid options and authorization. Existing tests unchanged. git diff --check passed. Changes remain uncommitted for review; issue stays in progress pending review/coverage/landing under workflow. No quoted-reply or timezone implementation changes included.

User explicitly requested discarding all changes. Restored tracked implementation/docs to HEAD and removed all untracked regression files and issue draft from this session. The MIME implementation is no longer present in the working tree; previous validation describes the discarded implementation only.

title: [zaq-pcj] Correct download_document MIME contract with immutable regression
